text:
About 34% of Indians lived in urban areas in 2017. World Bank and UN estimates put the figure at roughly 33.6%, up from 31.1% in the 2011 census. Neither 19% nor 64% from the team note matches any source I know of. The closest link is that about 66% of Indians were rural, but that is the opposite figure, so I'm not switching to either option.

CONFIDENCE: 85
